info.name: Revive HR System API
info.description:
Revive HR System API - full surface, one folder per controller.

**Auto-JWT**: a collection-level pre-request script signs in once per run and injects `Bearer {{accessToken}}` into every request, so no manual token handling is needed. Requests that must stay anonymous opt out with the header `X-Skip-Auth: true`.

Select the **Revive HR - Dev** environment before running.

item.name: 03 - Kiosk
item.description:
KioskController - `/api/kiosk`. The 6-digit station code is the only credential - no deviceId and no device token - so replacing broken hardware only needs the same code.

Codes are never hardcoded: `{{gym1StationCode}}` / `{{gym2StationCode}}` start empty and are filled by **04 - Station Codes > Get Current Station Code** (set `gymId` to 1 or 2 first). Run that once before this folder.

item.name: 04 - Station Codes
item.description:
StationCodesController - `/api/gyms/{gymId}/station-codes`. **Requires a JWT** - the collection auto-JWT supplies it, so nothing is pasted by hand.

Codes are generated server-side and never hardcoded. Set `gymId` (1 or 2) and run **Get Current Station Code** first - its test writes the live code into `gym{{gymId}}StationCode`, which the Kiosk and Attendance folders read. Rotating a code invalidates the previous one immediately, so the Rotate test writes the new code back the same way.
